plan_a_advantages: Includes a tempo session for threshold development.
Features a longer, controlled run (89 minutes) to build endurance.
More strategically designed to improve both aerobic base and speed-related fitness.
plan_b_advantages: More consistent running volume (all easy runs).
Incorporates trail runs for exploration, which could be beneficial for route familiarity.
reasoning: Plan A is the superior training plan for a trail runner aiming to become faster. It incorporates a dedicated tempo session to build threshold strength, a crucial component for sustained speed on trails, alongside a longer, controlled run. Plan B, while consistent, lacks this targeted intensity work and relies solely on easy runs, which won't significantly improve speed. The inclusion of a longer, more challenging run in Plan A is also more appropriate for a runner seeking to improve their performance.
